en.heading: Timber window frame and sill repairs
en.lead: We repair damaged timber frames and sills and check sticking or dropping sashes. Tell us which part of the window needs attention.
items: Frames and joints
We repair weathered frame sections and damaged joints, matching the surrounding timber profile.
Window sills
We check the sill ends and adjoining frame, replace affected timber and check how water reaches the sill.
Sticking or dropping sashes
We check the sash movement, fixings and surrounding timber to plan the repair.

zh.heading: 木窗框与窗台维修
zh.lead: 我们维修受损木窗框和窗台，并检查窗扇卡阻、下滑等问题。告诉我们窗户哪个部位需要处理。
items: 窗框与接缝
我们维修风化的窗框区段和受损接缝，匹配周边木材的截面造型。
木窗台
我们检查窗台两端及相邻窗框，更换受损木材，并检查进水和排水位置。
窗扇卡住或下滑
我们检查窗扇开关、固定点及周边木材，为您说明维修方案。

en.heading: Timber door adjustments and frame repairs
en.lead: We repair doors that rub, fail to latch or have damaged timber around the hinges and frame. We check the door and frame together before adjusting or replacing parts.
items: Door rubbing or sticking
We check hinge support, frame alignment and floor clearance, then adjust the affected parts.
Door will not latch
We check how the door closes and where the latch meets the strike plate.
Damaged jambs or frames
We repair damaged timber and fixing points and explain which sections need replacement.

zh.heading: 木门调整与门框维修
zh.lead: 我们处理木门摩擦、锁舌对位不良，以及铰链和门框周边木材损坏等问题。调整或更换部件前，会把门扇和门框一起检查。
items: 木门摩擦或卡住
我们检查铰链支撑、门框对位和门底间隙，再调整受影响的部位。
门关上后锁不住
我们检查关门状态，以及锁舌与锁扣板的对应位置。
门框或固定点损坏
我们维修受损木材和固定点，并说明需要更换的区段。

en.heading: Skirting board repairs and installation
en.lead: We repair and replace damaged skirting boards and fit skirting and architraves around floors, doors and windows. We match the profile, lengths and finish to the room.
items: Damaged or missing skirting
We replace affected lengths and match the existing profile and adjoining corners.
Skirting after new flooring
We measure the finished floor level and fit the skirting to the new floor and wall junction.
Door and window trims
We fit architraves and complete the joints and edges around the opening.

zh.heading: 踢脚线维修与安装
zh.lead: 我们维修、更换受损踢脚线，并安装地板、门窗周边的踢脚线和套线。根据房间情况匹配造型、长度和收尾要求。
items: 踢脚线损坏或缺失
我们更换受损区段，匹配现有造型及相邻转角。
铺新地板后的收边
我们按完成后的地板高度测量，处理地板与墙面之间的踢脚线收口。
门窗套线
我们安装门窗周边套线，完成接缝与边缘收尾。
